inscription.name: Resmo kyrka

carrier.currentLocationDescription: Nuvarande placering: Algutsrums kyrka, Algutsrums socken

textLayer.readingTransliteration: [tot-- × þ-(a)- (k)--(k)aʀ · ---- · …--- -tain · iftiʀ · sabiara · bruþur · sin · kuþ · hialbi salu hans ·]
textLayer.normalizationRunicSwedish: Dott[iʀ](?), Þ[i]a[gn](?), …gæiʀʀ(?) [letu] [retta] [s]tæin æftiʀ Sæbiorn, broður sinn. Guð hialpi salu hans.
textLayer.normalizationOldWestNorse: Dótt[ir](?), Þe[gn](?), …geirr(?) [létu] [rétta] [s]tein eptir Sæbjǫrn, bróður sinn. Guð hjalpi sálu hans.
textLayer.translationSwedish: … lät resa denna sten efter Sven, sin fader. Gud hjälpe hans själ och sankta Maria.
textLayer.translationEnglish: … had this stone raised in memory of Sveinn, his father. May God and Saint Mary help his soul.

images.caption: Runstensfragment Öl 2, inmurat i kyrkvägg, ur Ölands runinskrifter

inscription.editorialNotes: Fragment sekundärt inmurat i Resmo kyrka. Bär kristen förbön till Gud och sankta Maria.
